text.p: Villeurbanne of France closed the first chapter of their EuroLeague adventure with a lacklustre 83-81 win over Spain's Sevilla on Wednesday.
Both sides had already qualified for the last 16 after Greek title-holders Panathinaikos ruined Pau-Orthez's hopes with a 75-71 victory earlier in the day.
Villeurbanne finished second in Group G with 28 points and will have home advantage in the play-offs.
Sevilla, who were under pressure from Pau for fourth place, will face Bologna in the next round.
Villeurbanne made it difficult for themselves, as they often do, trailing 57-49 in the first few minutes after the break.
But once again they relied on Americain veteran Delaney Rudd, top scorer with 18 points, to put them in front at the last minute and score just before the horn blared.
